_help: Quest window (official UIWindow.img/Quest art). Game pixels in 1366x768. x,y = the window top-left (the list panel). The list panel is 245 wide, the detail panel 305 wide, both 396 tall (official art sizes). The rest are offsets inside a panel. bodyH = the body area height: the detail text stops there. secGap = the gap under a section title, secSpace = the gap before the next section.
